thread:
alex: Ran an nsys timeline for the Triton compile path on model gpt2-xl-quant during a warm start. Seeing intermittent compile stalls that line up with user-facing latency spikes.

alex: nsys excerpt (timing is relative):
```
nsys timeline: triton_jit_compile [GPU] 183ms
nsys timeline: kernel_selector_fallback [host] 22ms
nsys timeline: kernel_cache_miss -> compile_start 0.0ms
nsys timeline: compile_end -> dispatch 2ms
```

maria: link to perfetto: https://perfetto.local/trace/0x9f7a (uploaded)

jin: That 183ms compile is unusually high. any concurrent evictions or binary loads?

perf-bot: auto-note: kernel_cache_eviction bursts detected at 1939998108..1939998132 (4 evictions), avg cache_size 37/64

alex: Full nvprof lines attached in thread: compile op shows many calls into cuBLAS/cuDNN selector while Triton generates fallback kernels.

sam: Could be compile storm due to parallel requests hitting cold kernels. We saw similar pattern but with smaller magnitude on the last canary.

maria: Hypothesis: KV cache warmup triggers prefetch callbacks that race with Triton's kernel cache management, producing fragmentation and higher file/ELF loads -> longer JIT compile time.

jin: Quick repro plan:
1) run perfetto with nvtx ranges: 'compile','prefetch','dispatch'
2) capture kernel_cache/eviction timeline and host-side thread blocking
3) run with kernel_cache_prefetch=true and compare variance

alex: Command I'm using:
```
nsys profile --output trace.nsight --trace=nvtx,cuda,osrt --sample=cpu --capture-range=nvtx --duration=30s 
```

ops-bot: perfetto job queued: shard-9, start 1940001720, duration 30s, owner jin

sam: I tried kernel_cache_prefetch on a small test and saw variance drop ~40% (p95 compile 220ms -> 130ms) but median unchanged. Suggest A/B for a dedicated pool only.

maria: Good. Action items:
- jin: add NVTX markers around compile selector + prefetch (owner)
- alex: gather nvprof symbols and upload to perfetto trace explorer
- sam: run the prefetch A/B on dedicated pool and collect metrics

jin: I'll instrument today and run the perfetto at the scheduled time. Will include kernel cache metrics via /metrics/runtime/kernel_cache/size

alex: Also adding a small serialized compile queue in PR draft to avoid parallel compiles for the same kernel signature. link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987

maria: Thanks all. Let's reconvene after the trace results. :thumbsup:
